newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei futures end firm in bullish trade.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei futures end firm in bullish trade.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures finished higher on Thursday in line with gains on the cash market, which received a boost from active buying of semiconductor stocks.
Dealers said the dollar's rise against the yen and the Dow's firm tone on buying of high-technology stocks contributed to the rise on Nikkei cash and futures markets.
The benchmark Nikkei 225 December contract backed off from a high of 21,650 but closed firmer at 21,540 against a previous settlement at 21,375. Turnover was a moderate 20,600 lots.
"Generally speaking, the strong performance should continue but there's a lack of news to push it further," said a Japanese bank dealer.
He said the market should receive a boost from positive sentiment at the start of the second half of the Japanese fiscal year next week.

"I would want to see 21,800 tested tomorrow to confirm that the market has potential to rise further next week," said the dealer. He said the December Nikkei would also need to close above 21,300 on Friday to confirm a bullish trend on the charts.
